InboxDownload

Changelog

Small changes that make capturing and processing easier.

2026-10-25

Paste images alongside your thoughts

Paste a screenshot or attach an image to a new or saved entry, and see a preview beside your Markdown. Each entry owns its images, so deleting a processed entry moves its attachments to Trash with it.

Included in the next release; the packaged update is not available yet.

2026-10-25

Each thought gets its own Markdown file

Inbox now saves every entry as a separate, dated Markdown file, making individual thoughts easier to move into your own system. Existing daily journals upgrade automatically, with the originals kept as a backup.

Included in the next release; the packaged update is not available yet.

2026-10-22

Save thoughts when you are ready and edit older entries

Inbox now keeps your draft when you switch apps or restart, and saves it to your daily journal when you press Save or ⌘Enter. Click a saved entry to edit it, with Save and Cancel controls, and use the date picker to revisit any day.

Get it: Inbox 0.2.3.

macOS-only. Local files. Designed to be emptied.
